title: Quiet-Period Multiplier on Serious Violation Step-Downs (Seller Performance Standing)
content:
**Multiplier.** The share-applied points are the carried points multiplied by the step-down share and then by the quiet multiplier, rounded down to a whole point; the quiet multiplier is the long-quiet multiplier of 1.5 when six or more whole calendar months have passed since the most recent violation of any type was recorded, the short-quiet multiplier of 1.25 when three to five have passed, and one when fewer have passed.

This multiplier belongs to the step-down of serious violations on a Seller Performance Standing record. The quiet period is measured in whole calendar months, counted by calendar date, from the recording date of the most recent violation of any type — listing policy, restricted product, intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity or review manipulation — to the handling date. The product is worked to four decimal places before it is rounded down.

## Schedule

| Whole months since the most recent violation of any type | Quiet multiplier |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.5 |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 1.25 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | one |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date 15 September)

| Most recent violation recorded on | Whole months passed | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 6 | 1.5 |
| 16 March | 5 | 1.25 |
| 15 June | 3 | 1.25 |
| 16 June | 2 | one |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Carried points 8, step-down share 0.15:
- multiplier 1.5: 8 multiplied by 0.15 is 1.2, multiplied by 1.5 is 1.8000, rounded down to 1;
- multiplier 1.25: 1.2 multiplied by 1.25 is 1.5000, rounded down to 1;
- multiplier one: 1.2000, rounded down to 1.

Carried points 16, step-down share 0.2: with 1.5 the product is 4.8000, rounded down to 4; with 1.25 it is 4.0000, giving 4; with one it is 3.2000, giving 3.
